description_en: We sell 3-storey villas in Yzberisht. Land area 64.7 m2 and construction area 154.8 m2 - Ground floor with an area of ​​154.8 m2 and is organized in 3 rooms, toilet and balcony. -The first floor of the building has an area of ​​130.3 m2 and is organized in 4 rooms, a toilet and 2 balconies. - The second residential floor has an area of ​​130.3 m2 and is organized in 3 rooms, a toilet and 2 bathrooms. The villa has 224.8 m2 of land. There is a hood system, the doors and windows are thermally insulated. Price 800,000 euros. For a visit to the property, contact us now!
